_comment: DSCoop offsets database. NO absolute addresses — only signatures (IDA-style byte patterns) and
offsets relative to them. Patterns that are still empty are recon tasks (docs/00-recon-guide.md).
signatures.<name>: { pattern, offset, rip:{disp,len}, required, note }  -> see src/loader/src/sigscan.hpp
pointers.<name>:   { base: module|sig:<name>|ptr:<name>, add, chain:[...], type, note } -> see src/plugin/src/game_bridge.hpp
rtti.layout:       Decima RTTI record layout used by the RTTI dumper. verified=false until recon step 6 confirms it.
layouts.<name>:    byte layouts of engine structs we write (WorldTransform, ...). verified=false until recon confirms.

known_builds._comment: build_id (from dsloader.log) -> human label. Filled as players report their versions.

GameReadyMarker.note: Recon 1: any unique byte sequence in .text that exists once the engine is up (optional sanity check).

PlayerManagerInstance.note: Recon 3: 'mov rax,[rip+X]' / 'mov rcx,[rip+X]' that loads the global holding the local player (CE pointer-scan static base -> x64dbg xref). rip.disp/len are for a 7-byte 48 8B 05 xx xx xx xx form.

CameraManagerInstance.note: Recon 5: global pointer to the active camera (view-projection matrix lives below it).

RTTIFactory_RegisterType.note: Recon 6 (optional): function that registers an RTTI type — hooking it is the alternative to scanning .data.

Entity_SetWorldTransform.note: Recon 8: sets an entity's WorldTransform (teleport). Found by hardware bp on write to the player position -> the writing function. Assumed shape: void(void* entity, const WorldTransform*).

Game_Tick.note: Recon 7: per-frame game update called once per frame on the game thread (candidate: the caller of the player Mover update; find via hardware bp on write to the player position -> walk up the call stack to a function hit exactly once per frame). Assumed shape: void(void* self, float dt).

Entity_SpawnFromResource.note: Recon 8: engine function that instantiates an Entity from an EntityResource at a WorldTransform (HZD analogue: EntityResource::CreateEntity / WorldState::AddEntity). Assumed shape: void*(void* resource, const WorldTransform*).

Entity_Destroy.note: Recon 8 (optional): removes an entity from the world. Without it puppets of departed players stay as statues until reload.

Mover_SetLocomotion.note: Recon 9 (optional): sets locomotion parameters (speed/direction) on an entity's Mover/animation graph so puppets walk instead of sliding. Assumed shape: void(void* entity, float speed, float dir, u32 flags).

local_player.note: Recon 3: pointer to the local Player entity. Fill chain from the CE pointer scan (green static base -> offsets).

local_player_position.note: Recon 2-3: WorldPosition of Sam. Decima stores world coords as 3 doubles (X,Y,Z; Z up). If the CE scan finds floats use type vec3f.

local_player_yaw.note: Recon 4: orientation. Decima WorldTransform = 3x3 float rotation (9 floats, 36 bytes, usually padded to 48) immediately BEFORE the 3 doubles of WorldPosition, so try chain = position chain with the last offset minus 0x30. Alternatives: quat_f32 (x,y,z,w) or a single yaw f32.

local_player_health.note: Stage 4. Health of Sam (0..1 or 0..1000; the bridge normalises >1 by /1000).

camera_view_proj.note: Recon 5 (optional): 16 floats view*projection, if found directly. Otherwise the bridge builds it from camera_rotation + camera_position + camera_fov.

camera_position.note: Recon 5: camera world position (for distance culling).

camera_rotation.note: Recon 5: camera 3x3 orientation (same WorldTransform layout as the player). right/forward/up_row say which matrix row is which axis; swap them if markers land in the wrong place.

camera_fov.note: Recon 5: vertical field of view in degrees (default 55 is assumed when missing). Changes with the FOV slider / aiming.

local_player_entity_resource.note: Recon 8: pointer to Sam's EntityResource inside the Player entity (RTTI dump: field of type EntityResource*/Ref<EntityResource> in Entity/Player). Used to spawn puppets with the same model + collision capsule.

rtti._comment: Defaults follow the public Horizon Zero Dawn PC layout (same Decima generation). DS DC may differ: recon step 6 verifies name/kind/size offsets on a known class like 'Entity'.

world_transform.note: Recon 4/8: 3x3 float rotation (36 bytes, padded) followed by 3 doubles of position. Verify sizes against the RTTI dump (class WorldTransform).
